# Post-remediation compliance report (authoritative)

**Status**: AUTHORITATIVE. Generated by the US1 checker
(`test/verifiedTests/documentation/checkHeaderCompliance.m` +
`checkFunctionHeaders.m` + `headerComplianceExclusions.m`) over the full `src/`
tree after all six domains were remediated (T008–T248). Pairs with
`baseline.md` (the pre-remediation state) to satisfy SC-006.

**Generated from**: branch `014-src-header-compliance`, HEAD at the analysis
domain commit `fa094d826` (plus this closeout). Rule catalog:
`contracts/header-rules.md`. Deterministic text analysis (no solver / internet /
GUI / `initCobraToolbox`).

## Residual warning-severity (non-blocking) — before → after

| Domain | Warnings (before) | Warnings (after) |
|--------|------------------:|-----------------:|
| analysis | 149 | 98 |
| base | 34 | 1 |
| dataIntegration | 39 | 25 |
| design | 2 | 1 |
| reconstruction | 54 | 13 |
| visualization | 20 | 4 |
| **total** | **298** | **142** |

Warnings are `H-BODYGAP` (a legitimate body/section comment sits directly above
the first executable line) and `H-AUTHOR` (a provenance line not `% ..`-prefixed
on files not otherwise edited). They do not block the gate. Many were incidentally
cleared during remediation; the remainder were deliberately left because removing
them would mean detaching or deleting a body comment (H-BODYGAP) — an
undesirable, non-behaviour-preserving edit — rather than a header-format fix.

## Behaviour preservation

- `checkCommentsOnly.sh develop HEAD`: **1266 changed `src/*.m` files, all
  comments/whitespace-only** — no executable-line changes across the branch.
- The verifier joins MATLAB `...` line-continuations before comparing, so a
  behaviour-preserving multi-line-signature reflow (H-SIG) is not misreported as
  an executable change; any real token add/remove/reorder is still detected.
  One file (`src/analysis/persephone/runSeqC.m`) required such a reflow: its
  original `runSeqC( ... )` layout itself tripped H-SIG, and the rewritten
  signature is token-identical to HEAD once continuations are joined.

## How this was regenerated

```matlab
addpath('test/verifiedTests/documentation');
report = checkHeaderCompliance('src', 1);   % printLevel 1 = per-domain summary
```

Re-running on the same tree yields the identical report (deterministic).
